morecolorful.configuration.title: More Colorful Config
morecolorful.config.thermal_system.toolt:
Introduce thermal system for blocks. Now each block has a temperature level, and the temperature level will decrease while spreading.
Ice and snow only melt when the temperature is high enough, instead of depending on light level.
The conduction of heat will be affected by block's thermal resistance.
morecolorful.config.block_temperature.to:
Define a proper temperature value (Range: 0-15) for blocks with certain block state. Or you can also override the More Colorful configs. Block states are optional.
Format: "<block name>[block states]=<value>". Example: "minecraft:sea_lantern=0", "minecraft:redstone_lamp[lit=true]=12"
morecolorful.config.thermal_resistance.t:
Define a proper thermal resistance value (Range: 1-15) for blocks with certain block state, by default the value is 3. Or you can also override the More Colorful configs. Block states are optional.
Format: "<block name>[block states]=<value>". Example: "minecraft:stone=3", "minecraft:oak_fence[waterlogged=true]=4"
morecolorful.config.archaeology_loots.to: Add new loots in suspicious blocks, and you can get them by archaeology.
morecolorful.config.wind_system.tooltip: Wind is a global weather occurrence that randomly happens. The wind consists of two components on X axis and Z axis, and the max speed of each component is 17.5 (m/s).
morecolorful.config.wind_aiding_fire_spr: Wind can assist the fire spreading downwind.
Wind won't blow in dimensions in this list.
morecolorful.config.overworld_region_wei: The weight of More Colorful Biome regions in the overworld. Set to 0 to disable it.
morecolorful.config.disabled_biomes.tool: A list of biomes that are disabled from world generation.
morecolorful.config.allow_adding_feature: Allow More Colorful to add new features to vanilla biomes.
Allow More Colorful to add new mob spawns to vanilla biomes.
morecolorful.config.enhanced_leash.toolt: Make leads act like in vanilla 1.21.6+.
morecolorful.config.client.wavy_blocks.t: Allow blocks to wave in the wind.
morecolorful.config.client.wavy_particle: Allow wind to affect particle motion.
morecolorful.config.client.wind_and_rain: Allow wind to affect rain and snow.
morecolorful.config.client.wind_and_clou: Allow wind to affect cloud motion.
morecolorful.config.client.wind_sounds.t: Wind can make sound effects. It also allows the leaves rustling.
morecolorful.config.client.leaves_on_gro: Allow falling leaves and petal particles to stay on the ground for a while, instead of disappearing immediately.
morecolorful.config.client.confetti_on_g: Allow confetti particles to stay on the ground for a while, instead of disappearing immediately.
morecolorful.config.client.baby_villager: Baby Villagers have bigger heads. This doesn't affect their hitboxes.
